images.name: 办公室邀请
images.prompt:
Design ONE premium flat portrait roll-up exhibition banner for 企er, a Chinese enterprise research assistant. Exact 2:5 portrait aspect ratio (80 x 200 cm concept). Full artwork edge to edge, no physical stand, no perspective mockup. Use reference 1 as the approved small brand icon near the top: suited cream goose holding brass magnifier, preserve identity. Reference 2 supplies warm office aesthetic: navy cabinets, wood, brass lamps. Palette navy #222E39, ivory #F7F0E0, brass #B88B4C. Design 01: "办公室邀请". Upper third quiet navy with beautifully typeset LARGE modern sans serif Chinese text, center a vertically composed warm office doorway and desk with the suited goose investigating a paper, lower section a clean ivory text strip. Beautiful editorial illustration, warm professional office, not cyberpunk or generic AI.
EXACT text: top "企er"; subtitle "有出处的企业研究助手"; main headline on two lines "把信任交出去前" / "先看清这家公司"; three short features "汇集公开记录" "对照企业说法" "生成研究报告"; CTA "来，让小企查一查"; small footer "基于公开资料，不作安全担保". Accurate readable Chinese, strong hierarchy, few words, generous margins. Bottom 12% only background, no essential content (stand clearance). No QR code, no invented URL, no extra text or fake facts. Flat final banner artwork, exceptionally polished.
